claims.text: Wizard asks to accept license agreements
Select components to install (Server and/or Web UI)
Provide a license file
Service account (user and password under which services run and access the database)
System configuration check is performed
Choose Microsoft SQL Server: existing or new instance (default LOCALHOST\VEEAMSQL2017), database name, auth mode/credentials
Review installation settings
Specify data location
Security certificate or thumbprint, else new self-signed certificate generated
Ports: hub 9999, management 1989, Web UI 1280, ConnectWise plugin 9996 by default
Final installation summary review incl. automatic product update checks option
Before you begin: requirements met, required ports open, distributed machines can communicate
Machine must meet software and hardware requirements
Server component machine must have internet access
Microsoft SQL Server hosting the DB must be installed on a dedicated machine
Veeam Cloud Connect server must be installed on a dedicated machine
A Veeam Cloud Connect license must be installed on the Cloud Connect server
VB365 REST API must be installed and activated for the console to communicate with the server
Veeam ONE setup file from remote file share requires share location and credentials
Without internet, Veeam backup agent setup files must be delivered to the Server machine
In offline mode Veeam Installation Server accessed via its API endpoint to download setup files
Server requires certificate validation (CRL access) when connecting to Veeam Installation Server

B.notes: Lists peripheral items, not the setup wizard inputs; internet-access claim comes from a Veeam Intelligence limitation, and the sources only recommend (not require) dedicated SQL/Cloud Connect machines.

claims.text: Recon included in Advanced and Premium editions of VDP Universal License
Not supported for Veeam Data Platform Essentials

Up to 15 additional users in the Coveware account
